abstract:
AIM: Preoperative assessment of the pathological grade of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is critical for determining therapeutic strategies, yet conventional imaging often lacks sensitivity. This study investigated the incremental value of multiparametric spectral computed tomography (CT) imaging in the noninvasive prediction of PDAC differentiation.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: We retrospectively analysed 125 patients with pathologically confirmed PDAC (77 poorly differentiated, 48 nonpoorly differentiated). All patients underwent triple-phase contrast-enhanced spectral CT. Quantitative parameters, including virtual monoenergetic images (VMI) at 40 to 140 keV, iodine concentration (IC), effective atomic number (Zeff), and the slope of the spectral curve (λHU), were measured. A multiparametric logistic regression model was developed to integrate these biomarkers, and a nomogram was constructed to visualise the predictive performance.
RESULTS: Poorly differentiated tumours exhibited significantly lower values in 40 keV VMI, IC, Zeff, and λHU compared to nonpoorly differentiated tumours (P < .05). While individual spectral parameters showed moderate diagnostic ability, the exploratory three-phase combined model achieved the highest predictive performance (area under the curve [AUC] = 0.75). For clinical application, a simplified venous-phase nomogram based on four independent predictors was constructed, yielding an AUC of 0.68 with good calibration (Hosmer-Lemeshow P = .61).
CONCLUSION: Spectral CT-derived quantitative parameters differ significantly between PDAC differentiation grades. A multiparametric approach integrating these parameters yields moderate discriminative performance (AUC 0.75) for preoperative grading-superior to single-parameter analysis but insufficient for stand-alone decision-making. Thus, it may serve as a complementary tool to assist risk stratification, requiring cautious interpretation alongside established clinical and pathological assessments.
key_points_ko: 총 125명의 췌장관선암 환자(저분화 77명, 비저분화 48명)가 분석에 참여했습니다.
저분화 종양은 40 keV VMI, 요오드 농도, 유효 원자번호, 스펙트럴 곡선 기울기에서 유의하게 낮은 값을 보였습니다(P < .05).
다중 파라미터 결합 모델은 AUC 0.75의 예측 성능을 달성했습니다.
정맥기 기반의 간소화된 노모그램(nomogram)은 AUC 0.68을 기록했습니다.
summary_ko: 이 연구는 췌장관선암(PDAC)의 비침습적 분화도 예측을 위해 다중 파라미터 스펙트럴 컴퓨터단층촬영(CT)의 유용성을 조사했습니다. 병리학적으로 확진된 췌장관선암 환자 125명을 대상으로 삼중기 조영증강 스펙트럴 CT의 정량적 파라미터를 후향적으로 분석했습니다. 저분화 종양은 비저분화 종양에 비해 40 keV 가상단색화상(VMI), 요오드 농도(IC), 유효 원자번호(Zeff), 스펙트럴 곡선 기울기(λHU)에서 유의하게 낮은 값을 보였습니다. 세 가지 단계를 결합한 다중 파라미터 모델은 수술 전 등급 예측에서 중간 수준의 성능(곡선 아래 면적[AUC] 0.75)을 보였습니다.
title: Preoperative prediction of pathological grading in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma: the incremental value of multiparametric spectral computed tomography
title_ko: 췌장관선암의 수술 전 병리학적 등급 예측: 다중 파라미터 스펙트럴 CT의 추가적 가치
